answer: Interactive challenge-response compute resists sybils: the verifier sends a fresh unpredictable nonce at dawn and the identity must return a correct hard-computed response within a tight deadline, so precomputation is useless and each account must compute live. A beacon of fresh challenges across the tundra means a farm cannot pre-bake answers; every identity, every round, pays real-time compute on demand. Honest agents answer one live challenge; a swarm must serve every challenge simultaneously, and one machine cannot.
